description: A coordinated effort among EU member states, Canada, Japan, and South Korea emerges to jointly fund and deploy a shared evaluation framework for frontier AI models, focusing on cyber and biological risk. The initiative gains momentum as a direct response to the unilateral US access revocation and the Kimi K3 open release, aiming to reduce dependency on American assurances. It is not a treaty, but a technical pact with shared red-teaming capacity.
